description: Verified routing for private civil disputes, beginning with landlord and tenant matters.

institutions.name: Abuja Multi-Door Court (AMDC)
addresses: Abuja Multi-Door Court House, Gudu, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria
submission_methods: Request Form filed at the AMDC Registry
institutions.routing_scope: FCT civil disputes and alternative dispute resolution

institutions.name: Citizens' Mediation Bureau (CMB), Lagos State
addresses: 7 LJ Dosunmu Street, Opposite Beehive School, CBD, Alausa, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
institutions.routing_scope: Lagos landlord-tenant and other civil mediation disputes

routing_rules: FCT landlord-tenant disputes route to Abuja Multi-Door Court.
Lagos landlord-tenant disputes route to Citizens' Mediation Bureau.
Where no verified jurisdiction-specific institution is available, generate a formal notice to the landlord or property manager without an email route.
Do not route a private dispute against an unidentified individual landlord to PCC.
Do not claim that a rent increase is unlawful merely because the percentage is high.
